rules.description: Block one IP sending over 50 page requests in 10 seconds (scanners). API and MCP keep their per-key limits in the app.
rules.expression: not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/mcp") and not cf.client.bot
